integrity: The finite verifier checks 12,842 assignments and the exact finite formula. All asymptotic claims require the analytic proof; computation is not a substitute.
scientific_limitations: This result concerns independent uniform two-coordinate label assignments, not uniform random partitions. Earlier work already establishes the logical commutation property and exact class-refined finite enumeration; the new contribution is the early and late Poisson windows and the intervening failure regime. Rates of convergence are not estimated. Broader forbidden-subgraph or equivalence-pair generating-function results could imply portions of these limits. Independent scientific validation has not occurred.
title: Two Poisson windows for commuting knowledge in random two-agent S5 frames
